images.alt: A row of non-fiction books lined up in Dewey order. There are 10 books each one representing one of the "hundreds" in the Dewey classification.

post.text:
Do you know a keen reader of non-fiction? Drop them this tip!
Our 2 Dewey monthly book groups at Tūranga have space for more readers.
Our Wed group meets next on 24 June 6pm to 7pm and our Tues group is on 7 July 6pm to 7pm.
More in our event calendar: christchurch.bibliocommons.com/v2/events?q=...
